description.value: A family-owned organic winery on a 105-year-old Paynter family farm in West Kelowna, featuring a solar-powered straw bale tasting room and a seasonal food truck. The permaculture property includes farm animals (goats on the roof, sheep, chickens), a local artisan gift shop, and PACS-certified organic wines. A distinctive Okanagan stop where sustainability is baked into everything from the building to the bottle.

address.value: 3623 Glencoe Rd, West Kelowna, BC V4T 1L8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active, family-owned organic winery in West Kelowna with a tasting room, seasonal food truck, gift shop, and farm animals. OSM phone and address match the website. The food truck operates seasonally (Wed-Sun) offering takeout-style food. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities on the website or in OSM tags. OSM lists the community as 'Kelowna' but the website address clearly states 'West Kelowna'.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Kelowna' but website address is 'West Kelowna BC V4T 1L8' — West Kelowna is the correct municipality.
OSM email is admin@offthegridorganicwinery.com but the primary public contact email on the website is info@offthegridorganicwinery.com; admin@ is the accounts/HR address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active organic winery with tasting room and seasonal food truck in West Kelowna wine country. A natural and appealing stop for touring cyclists on Okanagan routes.
